hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f || exit 0; r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; case "$f" in /*) a="$f" ;; *) a="$PWD/$f" ;; esac; case "$a" in "$r"/CHANGELOG.md|"$r"/README.md|"$r"/docs/*.md|"$r"/changelog-assets/*.md) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; jq -n --arg f "${a#"$r"/}" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse",additionalContext:("Published document edited: " + $f + ". Re-read what you just wrote and cut, before doing anything else: (1) PROVENANCE - never name where a defect came from, who reported it, which engagement or client it surfaced in. (2) NARRATION about the work - how it was found, that it was reproduced first, what a diagnosis got wrong, how many tests ran. Say what changed and what it means for a reader. (3) AI CADENCE - tricolons used as rhythm, not-X-but-Y as a default sentence shape, pleonasm and padding, climax and countdown build-ups, negative contrast (it is not just X - it is Y). Plain declarative sentences.")}}'; }
